name: VALKO GT4

specs.notes: An original, fictional GT race car (the model is a generic design, no real make); its numbers a plausible GT3 balance-of-performance spec for the APEX GT CHALLENGE, set so it laps CINDER RIDGE within a few tenths of the AFFALTER GT3 on the AI's racing line (tests/race_ai_check.gd). A GT4 car the series' balance of performance lets run with the GT3s: a naturally aspirated flat-six in the middle (~44 % front), less downforce, so more power for its weight than a GT4's (real GT4s: ~450 hp, ~1,400 kg). The model: 4,640 x 1,980 mm, a 2,580 mm wheelbase at its own size.

garage.blurb: A GT4 sports car built up to race the GT3s: smaller, lighter wings and a howling flat-six. It carries speed through the corners the bigger cars brake for.

interior.notes: The model has no cabin (tinted glass over nothing): the shared race interior, as the other cars without one.

limitations: A low-poly model (~3,100 body triangles, flat colours, no textures, no cabin): made for a varied AI grid; plainer up close than the scanned GT3 cars.
